paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Nechunya. Mentioned in [Berakhot 23b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.23b.20), 25a. He inquired of Rav Yehuda.[^1][^2]

notes.text: In both passages Rav Yosef son of Rav Nechunya asks Rav Yehudah, who responds by quoting Shmuel.

Hyman’s second locator reads 25a. The second occurrence is at [Berakhot 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.24a.5), which [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2013&lang=en) also cites.
